title: 第9章 祸水东引坑死你们第10章 九转丹师
slug: 师门不要我反手建个更强的
content_zh:
玉牌碎了。
云星落还踩了一脚，把它踩得稀碎。
“我云星落当着天下修士的面宣布，我自动脱离天剑宗，自此和天剑宗再无关系。”
狂傲！
这一脚踩的不是宗门玉牌，而是天剑宗的脸面。
肖鹤再也顾不上风度，把剑一拔，“二师弟，小师妹，四师妹已经疯了，让我们一起把她擒回宗门。”
擒回宗门是假，杀她是真的。
她揭开了他们的遮羞布，这个耻辱他们怎么能忍。
云星落面色一变，这三个人每个都是金丹修为，她偷袭打一个还勉强，如果他们联合，她肯定打不过。
一对三，这种拼命三郎的蠢事她才不做。
好在这里是黑雾森林，打不过可以坑人。
只要他们敢杀凡人，就会被规则者轰杀。
她看向苏芫芫，嘴唇微勾，“小师妹，你确定要把我带回宗门，你就不怕我把你是邪修转……”
云星落想说她是邪修转世，世字还没出口，苏芫芫心头狂跳。
她的身份绝对不能暴露，否则对她来说就是灭顶之灾。
“四师姐，到现在你还在造谣我们，你该死！”
苏芫芫的眸子闪过凌冽的杀意，这一刻她忘了黑雾森林的规矩，只想要云星落死！
属于金丹修士的剑气汹涌而来，云星落频频后退。
但她没有惊慌，反而很是兴奋，她边退边喊，“杀人了，金丹修士杀凡人了！”
还真是屡试不爽，苏芫芫的剑还没抵达云星落身上，镇子中央，那道恐怖的能量再次爆发。

“猎杀凡人者，死！”
恐怖的力道从街道上狂扫而过，三人这才想起黑雾森林的规矩，不由得面色大变。
“小师妹！”
肖鹤和徐默同时扑向苏芫芫，把她护在中间。
肖鹤更是拼命大喊，“前辈，我等无意要杀人，云星落是我宗门孽徒，我等只是想把她带回宗门，请前辈明察。”
“原来如此，那大火气干嘛，打打杀杀可不好。”
一道慵懒的声音在镇子中间响起。
恐怖的力量撤了回去，但三人还是被余波冲击，虽不如红衣那般被打得吐血，一个个却还是气血翻涌，口角流血。
三人都心有余悸，差一点，他们就被轰杀在这里了。
肖鹤擦了擦嘴角的血，露出怨毒的眼神，“云星落，我们不过是想把你带回宗门，你却想要我们死，你太歹毒了！”
“啧啧啧，这就委屈了？”
content_en:
The jade plaque was broken.
Yun Xingluo also stepped on it, crushing it to pieces.
"I, Yun Xingluo, announced in front of the monks all over the world that I will voluntarily leave Tianjian Sect and have nothing to do with Tianjian Sect from now on."
Arrogant!
What he stepped on was not the jade medal of the sect, but the face of the Tianjian Sect.
Xiao He could no longer care about his grace and drew his sword, "Second Junior Brother, Little Junior Sister, and Fourth Junior Sister have gone crazy. Let us capture her back to the sect together."
Capturing her back to the sect was a lie, but killing her was real.
She lifted their fig leaf, how could they endure this shame.
Yun Xingluo's expression changed. Each of these three people had a golden elixir cultivation level. She could barely defeat one of them with a sneak attack. If they joined forces, she would definitely not be able to defeat them.
One on three, she wouldn't do such stupid things.
Fortunately, this is the Black Mist Forest. If you can't beat it, you can trick people.
As long as they dare to kill mortals, they will be killed by the rule makers.
She looked at Su Xiangqian, her lips slightly hooked, "Little junior sister, if you are sure you want to take me back to the sect, you are not afraid that I will turn you into an evil cultivator..."
Yun Xingluo wanted to say that she was the reincarnation of an evil cultivator, but before she could say the word "life", Su Qianqian's heart was beating wildly.
Her identity must not be exposed, otherwise it will be a disaster for her.
"Fourth Senior Sister, you are still spreading rumors about us, you deserve to die!"
Su Qianqian's eyes flashed with murderous intent. At this moment, she forgot the rules of the Black Mist Forest and just wanted Yunxing to die!
The sword energy belonging to the Jindan cultivator surged forward, causing Yun Xingluo to retreat frequently.
But she didn't panic. Instead, she was very excited. As she retreated, she shouted, "Killing people! Golden elixir monks have killed mortals!"
As it turns out, Su Xiangqian's sword hadn't even reached Yun Xingluo when the terrifying energy erupted again in the center of the town.
"Those who hunt mortals shall die!"
The terrifying force swept across the street. Only then did the three of them remember the rules of the Black Mist Forest, and their expressions changed greatly.
"Little junior sister!"
Xiao He and Xu Mo rushed towards Su Xiangqian at the same time, protecting her in the middle.
Xiao He shouted desperately, "Senior, we have no intention of killing anyone. Yun Xingluo is an evil disciple of my sect. We just want to bring her back to the sect. Please be aware of this, senior."
"I see, why are you so angry? It's not good to fight and kill."
A lazy voice sounded in the middle of the town.
The terrifying power was withdrawn, but the three of them were still hit by the aftermath. Although they were not beaten to the point of vomiting blood like Hong Yi, each of them still had blood boiling and their mouths were bleeding.
The three of them were all frightened. They were almost killed here.
Xiao He wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth and showed a malicious look, "Yun Xingluo, we just want to bring you back to the sect, but you want us dead. You are so vicious!"
"Tsk, tsk, tsk, are you aggrieved?"
